facts.text:
Commit memory (RAM + page file) is too low and can crash the game. Please raise it:

1. Press Win+R, type sysdm.cpl, press Enter.
2. Open the "Advanced" tab, then click "Settings" under Performance.
3. In Performance Options, open "Advanced", then click "Change" under Virtual memory.
4. Uncheck "Automatically manage paging file size for all drives".
5. Select your SSD, choose "Custom size", set [ Initial size: *MB ]; [ Maximum size: #MB ]. Click Set, then OK.
6. Restart your PC, Never disable the page file.
